name.description: Display name of the project (3–80 chars).

github.description: GitHub username of the author. Must match the folder name: configs/<github>/<slug>.json.

author.description: Who made the setup (credit the original author if it is not you).

lang.description: Language of summary and description. Default: en.

summary.description: One sentence shown on cards and search results (10–200 chars).
examples: Blazing-fast Wayland desktop with Waybar and Kitty.

description.description: Optional longer text: layout, workflow, what makes it special (max 2000 chars). Also searched.

license.description: SPDX license identifier of the upstream project.

version.description: Optional version label shown on the page.

updatedAt.description: Date of the pinned source.ref, as YYYY-MM-DD. Drives the "newest" sort.

distros.description: Distributions it was tested on (1–8). Use ["any"] for distro-independent themes and tools. Choices: arch = Arch Linux, endeavouros = EndeavourOS, manjaro = Manjaro, fedora = Fedora, nixos = NixOS, debian = Debian, ubuntu = Ubuntu, mint = Linux Mint, void = Void Linux, opensuse = openSUSE, gentoo = Gentoo, alpine = Alpine, any = Any distro.

category.description: Which part of the desktop it covers (main catalogue filter): dotfiles = Dotfiles & full rices, wm = WM & compositors, bar = Bars & panels, widgets = Widgets & shells, launcher = Launchers & menus, notifications = Notifications, dock = Docks, icons = Icon themes, cursors = Cursor themes, gtk-theme = GTK & shell themes, colorscheme = Color schemes & generators, login = Login & greeters, lockscreen = Lock screens, boot = Boot (GRUB / Plymouth), extension = DE extensions, tool = Tools & utilities, resource = Lists & guides.

wm.description: Window manager / compositor / DE it targets. Use "any" if it is not tied to one. Choices: hyprland = Hyprland, sway = Sway, river = River, niri = niri, wayfire = Wayfire, labwc = labwc, i3 = i3, bspwm = bspwm, awesome = AwesomeWM, qtile = Qtile, xmonad = XMonad, dwm = dwm, herbstluftwm = herbstluftwm, openbox = Openbox, gnome = GNOME, kde = KDE Plasma, xfce = Xfce, cinnamon = Cinnamon, cosmic = COSMIC, any = Any WM / DE, other = Other.

themeStyle.description: Dominant palette or look ("Browse by theme" filter): minimalist = Minimalist, cyberpunk = Cyberpunk, nord = Nord, gruvbox = Gruvbox, dracula = Dracula, tokyo-night = Tokyo Night, catppuccin = Catppuccin, solarized = Solarized, monochrome = Monochrome, rose-pine = Rosé Pine, material = Material, macos = macOS-like, dynamic = Wallpaper-based, other = Other.

tags.description: Up to 10 search keywords: components and features (waybar, rofi, auto-install). Do not repeat the WM, distro, display server or theme style: they are already filters.

specs.description: Optional component names shown in the spec table (all optional, free text).

url.description: Direct image link (https) on: raw.githubusercontent.com, user-images.githubusercontent.com, private-user-images.githubusercontent.com, github.com, i.imgur.com, i.redd.it, codeberg.org, gitlab.com. A clean 1080p/1440p capture works best.

alt.description: What the image shows, for screen readers (5–200 chars).
examples: Hyprland desktop with Waybar and two Kitty windows

caption.description: Optional short caption shown under the image.

screenshots.description: Screenshots, 1–8. The first one is the card thumbnail.

repo.description: Public repository on github.com, gitlab.com, codeberg.org.

ref.description: Exact version users install: a full 40-char commit SHA or a version tag, never a branch. Get a SHA with: git rev-parse HEAD

readme.description: README path in the repo, rendered on the page. Default: README.md.

source.description: Where the code lives and which exact version is listed.

install.description: How to install it (section 02 of the page). Required, except for "resource" (Lists & guides) entries, which are read online.

script.description: Optional: only if the upstream project ships its own installer script. Most entries leave this out and use steps.

url.description: Optional upstream install script: raw file URL pinned to a full commit SHA or a version tag (never a branch).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of that file: sha256sum install.sh

shell.description: Shell the script needs. Default: bash.

id.description: deps = install packages / clone, dotfiles = deploy config or theme, reload = apply or restart

title.description: Step heading shown on the page.

items.description: One shell command, written as you would type it. Follow docs/INSTALL-STANDARD.md: pinned clones and downloads, nothing piped into a shell, no deleting, root shells, bootloader or security changes. Lines starting with # are shown as notes for the reader (use them for interactive or per-distro steps); {{ref}} is replaced with source.ref.

steps.description: 1–3 steps (deps, dotfiles, reload), shown as manual steps and turned into the guided installer. Write plain commands: package installs, git clone + git -C <dir> checkout {{ref}}, cp into specific folders. The installer adds the plan, backups and rollback.

packages.description: Optional download links (AUR, Flatpak, .deb…) shown as alternatives.

review.description: Set by maintainers after reviewing the install steps. Leave out.

example.description: Internal: marks demo entries. Leave out.
